scope: Evidence-based compatibility for the actual Storage signing request metadata

production_observation.source: Parent agent narrowly scoped PostgreSQL diagnostic on the synthetic fixture only

primary_source.finding: The signing route passes the request content-type and numeric content-length headers as metadata.mimetype and metadata.contentLength into signUploadObjectUrl. The SDK signs with the two-byte JSON body '{}'. The uploader's permission probe therefore includes this transport metadata before any video bytes exist.
primary_source.rollback_finding: Database.testPermission intentionally rolls back its transaction after the permission check; actual uploads use a distinct operation.

exact_change: Inside the existing service_role + exact signing-operation + INSERT + version1 branch, allow absent/empty metadata or the exact observed two-key JSON object. Empty user_metadata and every current-lease/source/owner/session/asset check remain. Normal uploads and UPDATE still require full provenance and hash.
unchanged: No new or broader Storage grants or RLS policies
No new table or pending-upload bypass
No Edge or worker image change
No runtime gate or retry-attempt reset in this migration
No diagnostic values, credentials or signed URLs in the function
No missing-provenance exception for the actual upload operation

verification.additional_case: Observed transport metadata succeeds in a rolled-back probe; extra fields, wrong MIME, different length, string length, arrays/scalars and use during actual upload fail.
verification.actual_renderer_completion: Pending parent worker receipt at preparation time; not inferred from local tests or migration application.
